_about: KB-138 section 11, item 1: five prompts. Two answered with the fields named (C3), two declined (C4), one planted instruction blocked (C5). scripts/agentforce_explainer.py runs each in its own live preview session, as the agent user, and grades the answer with these checks. A check is case-insensitive. The account after each prompt is read back to show nothing changed.
